label: ASP.NET Core Web API (C#)
description: Controller-based Web API — ControllerBase + attribute routing, a scoped service layer, DI via the built-in container, DataAnnotations/FluentValidation on request models, Swagger from the OpenAPI package.

vars.name: ASP.NET Core
claude_rules: Backend and frontend are **separate concerns** — never mix them in a single agent
No business logic in controllers — controllers delegate to a scoped service
Request models are validated before the service is reached; services assume valid input

backend-developer.description: C# backend only — ASP.NET Core controllers, scoped services, EF Core entities and migrations, DTOs. Never touches frontend code.
backend-developer.lsp_trace: a DTO or service method to its implementation
backend-developer.impl_order: entity (+ migration) → DTOs → service → controller → DI registration
context: Backend source lives in `<% backend.src_dir %>`, one folder per feature
Controllers are thin: they validate, delegate to a scoped service, and shape the response
Services are registered in `Program.cs` (or a `ServiceCollectionExtensions`) and injected by interface
rules: Never put business logic in a controller — delegate to a scoped service
Inject dependencies by interface through the constructor; never `new` a dependency
Every public async method returns `Task`/`Task<T>` and is awaited — no `.Result` or `.Wait()`

scaffold.$comment: Verified against the .NET 10 SDK. Note `dotnet new sln` now emits a .slnx (XML) file, not .sln — so the verify command must let dotnet auto-discover the solution rather than naming a .sln path.

commands.run: dotnet new webapi --use-controllers --name <% project.pascal %>.Api --output src/<% project.pascal %>.Api
dotnet sln add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api/<% project.pascal %>.Api.csproj
dotnet add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api package Swashbuckle.AspNetCore

commands.note: the template's sample endpoint is replaced by the first real feature
